_note: Draft English of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bereshit 10 (Table of Nations). Saadia identifies the biblical ethnonyms with then-current geographical/national groups — keep both name forms ('the Turks (Gomer)') so readers can map Hebrew → JA identification. Notable: גמר=Turks, מגוג=Yajuj, מדי=Maday/Mahaat, יון=Greeks, תבל=China, משך=Khurasan, תירס=Persia; אשכנז=Slavs, ריפת=Franks, תוגרמה=Bulgars; אלישה=Massisa, תרשיש=Tarsus, כתים=Cyprus, דודנים=Adana; כוש=Abyssinia, מצרים=Egypt, פוט=Taft; סבא=Saba, חוילה=Zawila, סבתה=Zaghawa, סבתכה=Damas; שבא=Sind, דדן=India; ארך=al-Birs, אכד=al-Karkh, כלנה=al-Kufa; רחבות עיר=Rahbat al-qarya, כלח=al-Ubulla, רסן=al-Madain; לודים=Tinnis, ענמים=Alexandrians, להבים=Bahnasa, נפתחים=Farama; פתרסים=Bayma, כסלחים=Sa'idi/Upper-Egyptian, פלשתים=Filastiniyyin, כפתורים=Damietta; סיני=Tripolis; ארודי=Arwadites, צמרי=Homsites, חמתי=Hamawites; גרר=al-Khalus; עילם=Khuzistan, אשור=Mosul, ארם=Armenia; עוץ=Ghuta, חול=Hula, גתר=Gharamiqa, מש=Misha; פלג=Qasim ('the divider'), יקטן=Qahtan; מישא=Mecca, ספרה=Madina. v.9 מכוופא = 'fearsome' for גבר ציד — Saadia rationalizes 'mighty hunter' as 'fearsome mighty one'.

translations.1: And this is the exposition of the offspring of the sons of Noah — Shem, Ham, and Japheth; for sons were born to them after the flood.
translations.2: Sons of Japheth: the Turks (Gomer), Yajuj (Magog), Maday, the Greeks (Yavan), China (Tubal), Khurasan (Meshech), and Persia (Tiras).
translations.3: And the sons of Gomer: the Slavs (Ashkenaz), the Franks (Riphat), and the Bulgars (Togarmah).
translations.4: And the sons of Yavan: Massisa (Elishah), Tarsus (Tarshish), Cyprus (Kittim), and Adana (Dodanim).
translations.5: From these were scattered the islands of the nations in their lands; each group to its language, according to their clans and their nations.
translations.6: And the sons of Ham: Abyssinia (Cush), Egypt (Mizraim), Taft (Put), and Canaan.
translations.7: And the sons of Cush: Saba, Zawila (Havilah), Zaghawa (Sabtah), Qaqu (Raamah), and Damas (Sabtechah). And the sons of Raamah: Sind (Sheba) and India (Dedan).
translations.8: And Cush begot Nimrod; he was the one who began to be a mighty one in the earth.
translations.9: He was a mighty one, fearsome before God; and therefore it is said: 'Like Nimrod — a mighty one, fearsome before God.'
translations.10: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and al-Birs (Erech), and al-Karkh (Akkad), and al-Kufa (Calneh), in the land of Shinar.
translations.11: From that land Asshur went out; and he built Nineveh, and Rahbat al-qarya (Rehoboth-Ir), and al-Ubulla (Calah),
translations.12: and al-Madain (Resen), between Nineveh and al-Ubulla — it is the great city.
translations.13: And Egypt begot the Tinnisites (Ludim), and the Alexandrians (Anamim), and the Bahnasites (Lehabim), and the Faramites (Naphtuhim),
translations.14: and the Bayma (Pathrusim), and the Sa'idi (Casluhim) — from whom went forth the Palestinians (Philistines) — and the Damietta people (Caphtorim).
translations.15: And Canaan begot Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
translations.16: and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, and the Girgashites,
translations.17: and the Hivites, and the Arqites, and the Tripolitanians (Sinites),
translations.18: and the Arwadites, and the Homsites (Zemarites), and the Hamawites (Hamathites). And after that, the clans of the Canaanites were dispersed.
translations.19: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon — as you come to al-Khalus (Gerar) and to Ghazza (Gaza) — as you come to Sodom and Gomorrah, and Admah and Zeboiim, unto Lasha.
translations.20: These are the sons of Ham, according to their clans and their languages, in their lands, according to their nations.
translations.21: And to Shem also there was born — he, the father of all the sons of Eber, the older brother of Japheth.
translations.22: Sons of Shem: Khuzistan (Elam), and Mosul (Asshur), and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Armenia (Aram).
translations.23: And the sons of Aram: the Ghuta (Uz), the Hula (Hul), the Gharamiqa (Gether), and the Misha (Mash).
translations.24: And Arpachshad begot Shelah; and Shelah begot Eber.
translations.25: And to Eber two sons were born; the name of one of them was Qasim ('the divider' — Peleg), for in his days the earth was divided. And the name of his brother was Qahtan (Yoktan).
translations.26: And Qahtan begot Almodad, and Sheleph (al-Salaf), and Hadhramaut, and Yarah,
translations.27: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diqla,
translations.28: and Obal, and Abimael, and Saba,
translations.29: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Yovav — all these were the sons of Qahtan.
translations.30: And their dwelling was from Mecca (Mesha) — as you come to Medina (Sephar) — to the eastern mountain.
translations.31: These are the sons of Shem, according to their clans and their languages, in their lands and their nations.
translations.32: These are the clans of the sons of Noah, according to their offspring and their nations; and from them were the nations dispersed in the earth, after the flood.
